toefl:se:552.answer: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:552.fullSentence: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:552.japanese: 本メールがお元気なあなたに届きますように。
toefl:se:552.explanation: email の代わりに message を使った書き出しのバリエーション。
toefl:se:552.relatedInfo: I hope this email finds you well.

toefl:se:553.answer: I am writing to seek assistance regarding a technical issue I have encountered with a pair of headphones I purchased at your store last weekend.
toefl:se:553.fullSentence: I am writing to seek assistance regarding a technical issue I have encountered with a pair of headphones I purchased at your store last weekend.
toefl:se:553.japanese: 先週末に貴店で購入したヘッドホンで発生した技術的な問題について、サポートをお願いしたくご連絡しています。
toefl:se:553.explanation: seek assistance regarding ~ で「〜に関してサポートを求める」というフォーマルな表現。
toefl:se:553.relatedInfo: writing to ask for help with / writing to request support regarding

toefl:se:554.answer: After only a few days of use, I have noticed that the sound frequently cuts out on the right side, which has increasingly disrupted my listening experience.
toefl:se:554.fullSentence: After only a few days of use, I have noticed that the sound frequently cuts out on the right side, which has increasingly disrupted my listening experience.
keyPhrases: after only a few days of use
frequently cuts out on the right side
toefl:se:554.japanese: 使用してわずか数日で、右側から音が頻繁に途切れることに気づき、それが徐々に私のリスニング体験を妨げるようになっています。
toefl:se:554.explanation: which以下は前の内容全体を受ける関係代名詞の非制限用法。
toefl:se:554.relatedInfo: has been increasingly disrupting / has gradually worsened

toefl:se:555.answer: This issue affects both my enjoyment and my work, as I often use headphones for both leisure activities, such as listening to music and watching videos, and for critical tasks like attending virtual meetings and webinars.
toefl:se:555.fullSentence: This issue affects both my enjoyment and my work, as I often use headphones for both leisure activities, such as listening to music and watching videos, and for critical tasks like attending virtual meetings and webinars.
keyPhrases: affects both my enjoyment and my work
critical tasks like attending virtual meetings
toefl:se:555.japanese: 音楽を聴いたり動画を見たりする娯楽にも、オンライン会議やウェビナーに参加する重要な作業にもヘッドホンをよく使うため、この問題は私の楽しみと仕事の両方に影響しています。
toefl:se:555.explanation: both A and B の構造でenjoyment(娯楽)とwork(仕事)の両方への影響を示している。
toefl:se:555.relatedInfo: impacts both my leisure time and my work / affects me both personally and professionally

toefl:se:556.answer: The inconsistent sound output makes it difficult to focus and fully engage in these activities.
toefl:se:556.fullSentence: The inconsistent sound output makes it difficult to focus and fully engage in these activities.
keyPhrases: difficult to focus and fully engage
toefl:se:556.japanese: 音声出力が不安定なせいで、これらの活動に集中し十分に取り組むことが難しくなっています。
toefl:se:556.explanation: fully engage in ~ で「〜に十分に取り組む」という意味。
toefl:se:556.relatedInfo: hard to concentrate on / difficult to stay focused during

toefl:se:557.answer: Could you please advise me on available repair or replacement options?
toefl:se:557.fullSentence: Could you please advise me on available repair or replacement options?
keyPhrases: advise me on available repair or replacement options
toefl:se:557.japanese: 利用可能な修理または交換の選択肢についてアドバイスいただけますか?
toefl:se:557.explanation: Could you please advise me on ~? は丁寧にアドバイスを求める疑問文。
toefl:se:557.relatedInfo: Could you let me know the repair or replacement options?

toefl:se:558.answer: I would appreciate any guidance on how to proceed, including whether I should visit the store in person or if there are mail-in service options.
toefl:se:558.fullSentence: I would appreciate any guidance on how to proceed, including whether I should visit the store in person or if there are mail-in service options.
keyPhrases: appreciate any guidance on how to proceed
toefl:se:558.japanese: どう進めればよいか、店舗に直接来店すべきか、あるいは郵送でのサービスがあるかを含めて、ご案内いただけますと幸いです。
toefl:se:558.explanation: including whether ~ or if ~ で具体的な選択肢を列挙している。
toefl:se:558.relatedInfo: any advice on how to move forward / guidance on the next steps

toefl:se:559.answer: Thank you for your attention to this matter.
toefl:se:559.fullSentence: Thank you for your attention to this matter.
toefl:se:559.japanese: この件にご対応いただきありがとうございます。
toefl:se:559.explanation: attention to this matter で「この件への対応」という定型句。
toefl:se:559.relatedInfo: Thank you for looking into this.

toefl:se:560.answer: I look forward to your prompt response.
toefl:se:560.fullSentence: I look forward to your prompt response.
toefl:se:560.japanese: 迅速なお返事をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:560.explanation: promptは「迅速な」という意味の形容詞。
toefl:se:560.relatedInfo: I look forward to hearing from you soon.

toefl:se:561.explanation: Dear 〜,はビジネスメールの宛先を示す定型の書き出し。
toefl:se:561.relatedInfo: Dear Sir or Madam, / To whom it may concern,
src: ブレンダーの故障1・ブレンダーの故障2

toefl:se:562.answer: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:562.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:562.japanese: このメールが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:562.explanation: ビジネスメール冒頭の定型挨拶表現。
toefl:se:562.relatedInfo: I hope you are doing well. / I hope this message finds you well.

toefl:se:563.answer: I am writing regarding a problem with the blender that I bought from your store recently.
toefl:se:563.fullSentence: I am writing regarding a problem with the blender that I bought from your store recently.
toefl:se:563.japanese: 最近貴店で購入したブレンダーの不具合についてご連絡しています。
toefl:se:563.explanation: I am writing regarding〜は用件を伝える定型表現。
toefl:se:563.relatedInfo: I am writing to report an issue with / I am contacting you about

toefl:se:564.answer: After using it for the first time, it suddenly stopped working and will not turn on anymore.
toefl:se:564.fullSentence: After using it for the first time, it suddenly stopped working and will not turn on anymore.
keyPhrases: after using it for the first time
stopped working and will not turn on anymore
toefl:se:564.japanese: 初めて使用した後、突然動かなくなり、もう電源が入りません。
toefl:se:564.explanation: will notは「どうしても〜しない」という強い拒否のニュアンスを表す。
toefl:se:564.relatedInfo: no longer turns on / has completely stopped working

toefl:se:565.answer: I needed it last weekend to prepare a meal, but this issue caused an inconvenience and delayed my plans, which made me quite frustrated.
toefl:se:565.fullSentence: I needed it last weekend to prepare a meal, but this issue caused an inconvenience and delayed my plans, which made me quite frustrated.
keyPhrases: caused an inconvenience and delayed my plans
toefl:se:565.japanese: 先週末に食事の準備のために必要だったのですが、この問題のせいで不便が生じ、予定が遅れてしまい、とても苛立たしく感じました。
toefl:se:565.explanation: which madeは前の内容全体を受けて結果を述べる関係代名詞の用法。
toefl:se:565.relatedInfo: left me feeling frustrated / was quite an inconvenience

toefl:se:566.answer: Could you please let me know if it would be possible to repair the blender, or if there are any replacement options available?
toefl:se:566.fullSentence: Could you please let me know if it would be possible to repair the blender, or if there are any replacement options available?
keyPhrases: let me know if it would be possible to repair
toefl:se:566.japanese: ブレンダーの修理が可能かどうか、あるいは交換の選択肢があるかどうかを教えていただけますか?
toefl:se:566.explanation: Could you please let me know if〜は丁寧に確認を依頼する定型表現。
toefl:se:566.relatedInfo: Could you please advise whether / Please let me know if

toefl:se:567.answer: I would appreciate your help with this matter.
toefl:se:567.fullSentence: I would appreciate your help with this matter.
keyPhrases: appreciate your help with this matter
toefl:se:567.japanese: この件についてご協力いただけますと幸いです。
toefl:se:567.explanation: I would appreciate〜はビジネスメールで丁寧に感謝・依頼を伝える表現。
toefl:se:567.relatedInfo: I would be grateful for your assistance / Thank you in advance for your help

toefl:se:568.answer: I look forward to your response.
toefl:se:568.fullSentence: I look forward to your response.
toefl:se:568.japanese: お返事をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:568.explanation: メール末尾の定番の結び表現。
toefl:se:568.relatedInfo: I look forward to hearing from you. / I look forward to your reply.

toefl:se:569.explanation: メールの結びに使う丁寧な定型表現。

toefl:se:570.answer: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:570.fullSentence: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:570.japanese: 本メールが良い状態で届いていることを願っています。
toefl:se:570.explanation: 「メール」をmessageと言い換えた冒頭の挨拶表現。
toefl:se:570.relatedInfo: I hope this email finds you well. / I hope you are doing well.

toefl:se:571.answer: I am writing to express my concerns regarding a blender I purchased from your store last week.
toefl:se:571.fullSentence: I am writing to express my concerns regarding a blender I purchased from your store last week.
keyPhrases: writing to express my concerns regarding
purchased from your store last week
toefl:se:571.japanese: 先週貴店で購入したブレンダーについて、懸念をお伝えするためにご連絡しています。
toefl:se:571.explanation: express my concerns regarding〜で不満・懸念を丁寧に伝える表現。
toefl:se:571.relatedInfo: writing to raise a concern about / writing to flag an issue with

toefl:se:572.answer: After using it for the very first time, I was surprised to find that it stopped working entirely.
toefl:se:572.fullSentence: After using it for the very first time, I was surprised to find that it stopped working entirely.
toefl:se:572.japanese: 本当に初めて使用した後、完全に動かなくなっていることに気づき驚きました。
toefl:se:572.explanation: was surprised to find that〜は「〜だと気づいて驚いた」という表現。
toefl:se:572.relatedInfo: was shocked to discover that / to my surprise

toefl:se:573.answer: Initially, it functioned perfectly, but after blending a basic smoothie, it refused to turn on again despite following the provided instructions carefully.
toefl:se:573.fullSentence: Initially, it functioned perfectly, but after blending a basic smoothie, it refused to turn on again despite following the provided instructions carefully.
keyPhrases: despite following the provided instructions carefully
toefl:se:573.japanese: 最初は完璧に機能していましたが、簡単なスムージーを作った後、説明書の指示を注意深く守ったにもかかわらず、二度と電源が入らなくなりました。
toefl:se:573.explanation: refuse to〜は「(機械などが)どうしても〜しない」という擬人的な表現。
toefl:se:573.relatedInfo: would not turn on again / stopped responding entirely

toefl:se:574.answer: This unexpected malfunction has left me quite dissatisfied with the product, as I expected a reliable appliance for my kitchen needs.
toefl:se:574.fullSentence: This unexpected malfunction has left me quite dissatisfied with the product, as I expected a reliable appliance for my kitchen needs.
keyPhrases: has left me quite dissatisfied with the product
toefl:se:574.japanese: この予期しない故障のせいで、この製品にとても不満を感じています。台所での使用に信頼できる家電を期待していたからです。
toefl:se:574.explanation: leave + O + 形容詞で「(状況が)人を〜な状態にする」という結果を表す。
toefl:se:574.relatedInfo: has made me quite disappointed / has left me unsatisfied

toefl:se:575.answer: It seems unusual for a new item to fail so quickly, especially after such limited use.
toefl:se:575.fullSentence: It seems unusual for a new item to fail so quickly, especially after such limited use.
keyPhrases: seems unusual for a new item to fail so quickly
toefl:se:575.japanese: 特にこれほど限られた使用の後で、新品がこんなに早く故障するのは珍しいことのように思われます。
toefl:se:575.explanation: It seems + 形容詞 + for A to do は「Aが〜するのは…に思える」という表現。
toefl:se:575.relatedInfo: it is unusual that / it seems odd that

toefl:se:576.answer: I am keen to resolve this issue swiftly and efficiently.
toefl:se:576.fullSentence: I am keen to resolve this issue swiftly and efficiently.
toefl:se:576.japanese: この問題を迅速かつ効率的に解決したいと強く思っています。
toefl:se:576.explanation: be keen to doは「ぜひ〜したい」という強い意欲を表す表現。
toefl:se:576.relatedInfo: eager to resolve this matter / hope to settle this quickly
